mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_calls (session_id, turn_id, trace_id, provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, success, error_message, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{traceId}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO tool_invocations (session_id, turn_id, trace_id, tool_name, arguments, duration_ms, success, error_message, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{traceId}, #{toolName}, #{arguments}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, #{createdAt})
